results.content: # Tesla Owner Hits Unprecedented 25,000-Mile Full Self-Driving Streak. A Tesla driver has set a massive record after passing 25,000 miles on their Full Self-Driving streak counter, marking the longest recorded distance without manual intervention. To celebrate reaching 25,000 miles, the vehicle’s display screen triggered a digital confetti animation across the interface. The celebration animation last appeared on Moss’s screen when he hit the 5,000-mile streak marker. Moss took part in a full FSD drive across Canada and even setting the latest ‘Cannonball’ run EV record, so he’s no stranger to maximizing FSD 14 endurance drives.
